descriptor: Studio for dark-mode interfaces and light effects

voice.summary: Afterglow writes in low light: few words, lots of space, and one bright idea per line. It invites you to move and discover, treating the reader as someone who enjoys finding things.
dos: Use one short sentence per idea
Invite action with a verb, such as explore, move, look
Let whitespace do part of the talking
donts: Never use more than two lines of body text

taglines: Find the light in the dark
Details that wait to be found
Dark by design, bright on purpose
boilerplate: Afterglow is a small design studio crafting dark, interactive interfaces where light, motion and hidden details reward the people who explore them.

microcopy.error: The light went out. Refresh to relight it.
microcopy.empty: Nothing revealed here yet. Keep moving.

logo.note: A single spark is the light that appears wherever the cursor goes.
